resources.string: You can change it anytime in About → Language. Some screens are still being translated and appear in Chinese for now.
Can\'t find your language? Contact the developer and help translate.
A status bar and system UI customization module for ColorOS
Known as konwo on Coolapk and AiingJie everywhere else. Contact details are on the About page.
Fine control of the clock, icons, network speed, battery and more
Add features with plugins and turn them on or off anytime
Requires root and LSPosed (an Xposed framework). Designed mainly for ColorOS.
Modifying the system UI carries risk. If something goes wrong, turn on safe mode or disable the module. Back up important data first.

This module is free forever. Donations are completely optional, and every feature works without one.\n\nNever pay anyone for this module, an activation code or a so-called paid version. If you paid for it, ask for a refund and report the seller.
Plugins are separate from this module and may cost money, the developer\'s own included. Each plugin\'s own description says whether it is paid and how to get it.

This project is open source under the GPL-3.0 license. You may study, modify and share the code, provided that you:

This module is provided “as is”, without any warranty. You are responsible for any system problems or data loss that result from using it.\n\nThe module collects no personal information. It only goes online when you check for updates, download fonts, icons or plugins, or open the thanks wall.
